notes: Read all 120 source lines before editing. This is non-visual hook/utility code; logic, state names, API paths, unit handling, and the export barrel surface are ported faithfully into native-compatible TypeScript. Only react, @tanstack/react-query, and the already-ported native ../api/settings + ../api/types are imported — no DOM modules, HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI components.

L1-2 imports: `useEffect` from react and `useQuery` from @tanstack/react-query ported verbatim (react-query is a native dependency; the sibling api/hooks/useSettings already uses it). `useSyncExternalStore` is additionally imported to back the inlined notification-sound store.

L3-4 `getSettings` and `AppSettings` resolved to the native parity layer: `import {getSettings} from '../api/settings'` and `import type {AppSettings} from '../api/types'` (web `@/api/settings` / `@/api/types`). Native AppSettings (api/types.ts) carries every field the defaults object sets.

L5 `setGlobalPrecision`/`setGlobalLocale` (../lib/numberFormat — not yet ported natively): inlined native-safe module globals with identical clamp(0..20) precision and empty/whitespace -> 'en-US' locale fallback, plus matching getGlobalPrecision/getGlobalLocale getters so the values are read by a future native formatter — the native stand-in for the shared formatter state.
L6 `resolveLocale` (../lib/locale — not yet ported): inlined 1:1 (string && trim().length>0 ? locale : 'en-US') with the same JSDoc rationale about empty-string locale crashing Intl formatters.

L7 `subscribe` (../lib/broadcast — BroadcastChannel + localStorage storage-event cross-tab bus, browser-only): replaced by a native-safe settings bus (subscribeSettingsBus) following the useEditLease precedent — auto-detects a global BroadcastChannel (react-native-web/host polyfill) with the same `_from: TAB_ID` envelope + self-filter, accepts a host-injected SettingsBusTransport via setSettingsBusTransport, and is otherwise a documented no-op (SETTINGS_BUS_UNAVAILABLE_REASON). useSettings only subscribes (never broadcasts), so only the receive side is modelled.

L8 `TOPICS` (../lib/broadcastTopics — not yet ported): inlined as `const TOPICS = {SETTINGS_CHANGED: 'settings.changed'} as const` so the call-site filter `msg.type !== TOPICS.SETTINGS_CHANGED` is preserved verbatim and stays wire-compatible with the web bus discriminator.

L10-23 notification-sound re-export barrel: the web re-exports DEFAULT_NOTIFICATION_SOUND_PREFS, NOTIFICATION_SOUND_CATEGORIES, getNotificationSoundPrefs, setNotificationSoundPrefs, useNotificationSoundPrefs, and the NotificationSoundCategory/NotificationSoundPrefs types from @/lib/notificationSound. That module is browser-only (localStorage + WebAudio/OscillatorType DOM types) and not yet ported, so the localStorage-backed prefs store is inlined here as an injectable storage seam (NotificationSoundPrefsStorage + setNotificationSoundPrefsStorage), mirroring the useAchievementCelebrationPrefs native port; all 5 values + 2 types are exported so the barrel contract is preserved. The non-re-exported WebAudio player / mapNotificationToCategory are intentionally out of scope for this file. Category list, default prefs (master:false, per-category gates, volume 0.6), clamp, normalize, useSyncExternalStore snapshot caching, getNotificationSoundPrefs sync accessor, and the shallow-merge setNotificationSoundPrefs patch semantics are all ported faithfully.

L25-58 `defaults: AppSettings` object ported verbatim — every key/value preserved exactly (unit_of_length 'km', unit_of_temp 'C', unit_of_pressure 'bar', preferred_range 'rated', language 'en', base_cost_per_kwh 0.12, api_suspended false, theme 'neon-cyan', mode 'dark', custom colors, gas_* fields, decimal_precision 2, quiet hours, alert_digest_mode 'instant', currency_symbol '$', locale 'en-US', tz_display_default 'vehicle', timezone_user '', tab_badge_enabled true, critical_flash_enabled true, ui_density 'comfortable', time_format_default 'relative', chart_palette 'cb_safe', ai_mode 'off', ai_features {}, ai_provider_config {}, ai_cost_cap_cents 0).
L60-67 useSettings JSDoc preserved verbatim (5-min cache; conversion lives in useUnits; currency/cost formatting in useFormatting).
L68-74 `useSettings()` + useQuery ported verbatim: queryKey ['settings'], queryFn getSettings, staleTime 5*60*1000, retry 1, destructuring `{data: settings, refetch}`.

L76-84 raw/locale normalization ported verbatim incl. the comment: `raw = settings ?? defaults`; `s` keeps raw when locale is non-empty/trimmed else spreads `{...raw, locale: defaults.locale}` so every downstream consumer sees a valid BCP-47 tag.
L85-88 `decimals = s.decimal_precision ?? 2`, `locale = resolveLocale(s.locale)`, and the density narrowing ('compact'|'spacious' pass-through else 'comfortable') ported verbatim.
L90-94 first effect ported verbatim: syncs setGlobalPrecision(decimals) + setGlobalLocale(locale) on [decimals, locale] so formatters stay aligned with settings.

L96-102 second effect ported faithfully: returns subscribeSettingsBus(msg => { if (msg.type !== TOPICS.SETTINGS_CHANGED) return; void refetch(); }) on [refetch] — the web cross-tab settings refetch, now via the native settings bus seam (no-op on pure native, live when a BroadcastChannel/host transport exists).

L104-108 derived flags ported verbatim: isMiles (unit_of_length==='mi'), isFahrenheit (unit_of_temp==='F'), isPSI ((unit_of_pressure ?? 'bar')==='psi'), rangeType (preferred_range as 'rated'|'ideal').
L110-120 return object ported verbatim with identical keys/order: settings (the normalized `s`), isMiles, isFahrenheit, isPSI, decimals, locale, density, rangeType.
